name: io.agora.avc.push.xiaomi.MiPushMessageReceiver
description: The Agora AVC conference app uses Xiaomi Mi Push to handle delivery, arrival, error, and registration events. When a user taps a Xiaomi push message containing a meeting invitation, this Receiver opens the invitation in the conference app.
disableEffect: Xiaomi push messages and meeting invitations delivered through Xiaomi will no longer be received or opened.
